summary: The most recent campus crime data for Boise State University indicates a notable increase in incidents related to vandalism and hit-and-run cases. Specifically, there were multiple reports of vandalism in December, contrasting with fewer incidents in the previous month. Hit-and-run incidents also remain a significant concern, with several cases reported as open investigations. Alcohol-related violations continue to be prevalent, though many have been resolved through referrals to the Dean of Students. The data reflects ongoing challenges in maintaining campus safety, particularly in areas with high foot traffic and parking.
